scope: Independent visual review of all twelve HD PNG poses through actual browser alpha compositing on dark and light backgrounds, including hand, foot and waist enlarged panels.

limitations: This is a visual quality review of stylized Q-proportion artwork, not an exact anatomical certification.
Occluded digits are assessed by plausible overlap and connected contours; every hand is not required to display all five digits.
This receipt does not certify native desktop HD loading, animation transitions, or installer behavior.
No alpha-channel numerical validation was performed by this reviewer; the parent task owns numerical bounds and native image size validation.

observations.feet: Both shoe fronts face forward with a small central gap. No inward toe rotation is evident; lower legs connect to the shoes without a crossing axis.
observations.clothing: Ivory bodice is clearly visible between the small chest bow and green waist band. Gathered skirt starts below the band, not at the chest.
observations.headAccessories: Two small matched daisy bows attach to side locks and have short downward tails; the ears remain clear.
observations.transparency: Hair and tail contours composite cleanly on both backgrounds. No conspicuous opaque rectangle, colored haze, or isolated opaque speck is visible.
